title: ESTIMETR Manual Take-off with Evidence
description: เปิดให้ถอดปริมาณด้วยมือได้จริงบนตาราง takeoff_runs/takeoff_items/evidence_references ที่มีอยู่ โดยหน่วยถูกจำกัดเป็นชุดปิด ปริมาณคำนวณด้วยจำนวนเต็มสเกลจึงไม่มีความคลาดเคลื่อนจากทศนิยมลอยตัว และรายการจะยืนยันได้เมื่อมีหลักฐานอ้างอิงแล้วเท่านั้น
scope: open one manual take-off run per project, with the open run enforced under a project row lock
record take-off items with a closed unit set, a work-group category and an exact decimal quantity
require at least one evidence reference before a quantity can be confirmed, checked inside the confirming transaction
lock a confirmed line against evidence changes and deletion so the audit trail stays intact
close a run with a fingerprint of the confirmed lines only, so a later estimate can prove which quantities it priced
total confirmed quantities per unit without rounding and without merging units
scope every take-off read and write through projects.organization_id, since the take-off tables carry no organization column
verification: pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint (0 warnings), pnpm test (94 passed with the opt-in database suites enabled), pnpm build and pnpm security:check pass
unit tests cover decimal parsing and refusal, exact addition where floating point fails, the numeric(18,6) boundary, form validation and the evidence gate

opt-in PostgreSQL tests cover run idempotency, refusal to confirm without evidence, the lock on a confirmed line, cross-organization reads and writes returning nothing, run closing that excludes unconfirmed lines, every write refused on a locked project and the audit record carrying the measured value
the item lock test was confirmed to fail when the row lock is removed: without it one quantity is confirmed twice and two audit events are written
unauthenticated requests to /apps/estimeter, /apps/estimeter/projects/{id} and /apps/estimeter/projects/{id}/takeoff all returned the access gate
GitHub push and release tag pending user approval
rollback: Revert the slice 3 commit or return to tag v0.14.0-estimeter-project-lifecycle. No migration runs in this release. Rows already written to takeoff_runs, takeoff_items, evidence_references and audit_events stay valid and readable; reverting only removes the route that writes them.
constraints: No schema change or migration in this release; takeoff_runs, takeoff_items and evidence_references are used as shipped by migration 0000.

takeoff_items has no column for a dimension breakdown, so the measurement basis is recorded as an evidence note in the operator's words. Re-checking the arithmetic of a quantity is not possible until the schema slice adds structured dimensions (IP-045).
evidence_references.document_id stays null because drawing upload is not built yet; evidence is a written reference to a drawing sheet and page.
takeoff_runs.input_hash is NOT NULL and was designed for a computed run, so a manual run stores a hash of the project, runner and operator that opened it.
The work-group categories are working groups only, not a claim of ปร.4 compliance; that mapping needs the official DPT form (IP-042).
No price, Factor F or VAT is computed anywhere in this release.

items.title: Record manual take-off quantities with a mandatory evidence reference before confirmation
Add structured dimension breakdown to take-off items so a quantity's arithmetic can be re-checked
Validate the official DPT source for ปร.4, ปร.5 and ปร.6 before claiming export compliance
Apply GitHub branch protection once the plan upgrade allows it
